svg.title: Blelloch: sum up the tree, then pass prefixes down
svg.desc: Two panels on the values 3 1 7 0 4 1 6 3. Up-sweep, top to bottom: at offset 1 the right element of each pair adds the left, giving 3 4 7 7 4 5 6 9; at offset 2, 3 4 7 11 4 5 6 14; at offset 4, 3 4 7 11 4 5 6 25, the total last. Down-sweep: the root is cleared to 0 (purple), giving 3 4 7 11 4 5 6 0; at offsets 4, 2 and 1 each left child takes its parent's value and each right child the parent plus the old left value, giving 3 4 7 0 4 5 6 11, then 3 0 7 4 4 11 6 16, then the exclusive scan 0 3 4 11 11 15 16 22. Orange cells are written at that level, and the total and the finished scan are outlined green; 14 additions in all.
svg.text: Blelloch: sum up the tree, then pass prefixes down
The post's eight values, with the tree indices of scan.cu; the end rows are printed by scan_model.py.
Up-sweep: a reduction tree in place
Each sweep has log₂ 8 = 3 levels and 7 additions, 14 in all, against 17 for Hillis-Steele.
